scope: Phone number reuse limits, unchangeable linked numbers, phone-only signup versus API verification, giffgaff eSIM migration and non-EU roaming boundaries; targeted older merchant rechecks; no new Plus wholesale supplier.

merchant_rechecks.name: PAYPRM Codex phone help
merchant_rechecks.claim: Plus/Pro upgrade removes Codex prompt for over 98% (merchant anecdotes, no controlled verification)

sources.fact: One phone number can be used for verification on up to three OpenAI accounts' first API key; not an unlimited reusable API SMS number. Account deletion/re-registration exceptions have separate 30-day conditions.
OpenAI currently does not allow changing or updating phone number associated with an account for ChatGPT or API.

Phone-only signup is limited to eligible new users and shown choices; Plus/Pro/Business still require verified email; phone-only signup and first API key verification are distinct checks; recycled number may cause too-many-signups; eligible deleted consumer accounts may release phone number after 30 days.

eSIM activation must use giffgaff app on target device; no QR/SM-DP+/manual codes. Existing eSIM switching can require SMS to current giffgaff number. Broken eSIM recovery uses new physical SIM while already logged in, without receiving SMS; UK SIM delivery constraint from prior round remains.

Roaming site lists China as a non-EU travel data add-on destination, but travel data add-ons do not include calls/texts. PAYG roaming offers texts from 30p per outgoing text generically; China-specific final tariff not extracted from the dynamic country selector, so exact China SMS charge remains unknown.

Merchant cites over 98% customer feedback that upgrading Plus/Pro removes Codex phone prompt. There is no independently audited sample/denominator and no promise of permanent absence of verification; merchant also offers separate Codex SMS product. Same merchant claim had been noted previously.
GETGPT Pro Plus display remains CNY179/month for own account; exceeds CNY170 even before invoice/payment fees. No price change compared with prior 2026-11-03 evidence; no qualified wholesale proof.

evidence_categories.platform_official: API phone reuse at most 3, no associated-number self-update, phone-only and first-API verification distinct
evidence_categories.operator_official: eSIM activation/replacement constraints, roaming data add-on excludes SMS, China SMS tariff cannot be read from dynamic selector
evidence_categories.merchant_claim: PAYPRM non-audited >98% feedback is not OpenAI promise
evidence_categories.inference: shared/recycled phone inventory adds account-linking and reuse risks; could fail despite receiving generic SMS
evidence_categories.actual_test: No purchases, number possession, OTP completion, validated supplier invoice, or wholesale transaction.
